biotools.summary: BALROG-MON is a Nextflow pipeline that analyzes metagenomic long-read data to detect pathogens, annotate antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs), and predict their origin. It automates a flexible analysis tool for exploring diverse metagenomic samples for pathogens and antibiotic resistance.
